title: Equinox eclipse: manage the payload power
summary: It is equinox: every night the satellite passes through Earth's shadow for over an hour.
goals: Understand GEO eclipse seasons around the equinoxes
Budget payload power against battery energy
situation: Part of the battery has failed. Full payload (18 channels) through the coming eclipse would take the battery below 30%, and the onboard rule would switch all amplifiers off. Reduce the channels, survive the eclipse, then restore them.

steps.text: Reduce the amplifiers to 12 channels: pl.amps CHANNELS 12.
steps.hint: Amplifier power scales with the number of channels.

steps.text: Leave the eclipse with the service on.

failText: The battery reached the shedding limit: all amplifiers would be switched off.
successText: Customers kept most of their service through the eclipse.
